I feal that Hydronias blockade is different then what you were going for:
Hydronia is blockade is targeting one spesific nation, WMW, and no one ells, a nation/company that is seeming to be doing direct deals with Hydronias literal enemy (pluss some other shady looking things).

Your blockade targeted everyone, exept a few spesific ones such as your intended allies, regardless if they were hostile, neutral or even friendly to an allied nation.
This would have created problems for nations that have not realy done anyting wrong and might even be trading with Hydronia, and other nations there, wich would in turn damage the economy of the nations you are trying to help and turn more neutral nations that haven't chosen a side to turn to TK to make up their loss of trade by gaining his approval for trade and interaction on the continent of Elseyr and its immidiate zone of influence (since he and his allies are rather big powers there).
In general your blockade, while well intentioned, was not wery well planed, there was other ways you could have done someting similar but not gotten anywere near the same amount of pushback or hostile reactions if you had first comunicated with Hydronia and his allies to find out what would be the best way to do someting like that (or what you could do to help).
